title: 간판 읽기 2: 미용실·세탁소·부동산·문구점
objective: By the end, you can read the signs 미용실, 세탁소, 부동산 and 문구점 aloud. You will also know when ㅅ or ㅈ becomes tense after a ㄱ or ㅂ final consonant.
summary: Read four common neighborhood shop signs and say them correctly, including the tense sound in 세탁소.

task.title: Read and sound out
task.line: Use the rules on page 1 to read each word or sign, then write or choose your answer.

words.exampleMeaning: I'm going to the hair salon tomorrow.
I look at places to live through the real estate office.
I buy a pen at the stationery store.

words.meaning: open (for business), on a shop sign

letters.sound: [ng] at the bottom of a block: 용, 동

letters.as: like l in 'feel', tongue tip up

letters.sound: ㅅ, ㅈ become tense: 세탁소 [세탁쏘], 영업 중 [영업쭝]
letters.as: a tight, sharp s or j, with no puff of air

exercises: Write how it sounds in [ ]: ① 학생 ② 입장
Does ㅅ or ㅈ become tense? Write Yes or No: ① 수선 ② 책상 ③ 시장
Where do you go? Write the shop name in Korean: ① 머리를 잘라요. ② 지우개를 사요. ③ 방을 구해요.
Read the sign 「별 문구점 · 영업 중」 and answer: ① What kind of shop is it? Write it in Korean. ② Is it open now? Write 예 or 아니요.
Choose the correct sound, (a) or (b): ① 국수 (a) [국수] (b) [국쑤] ② 가방 (a) [가방] (b) [가빵] ③ 답장 (a) [답장] (b) [답짱]
answers: ① No ② Yes [책쌍] ③ No
① 미용실 ② 문구점 ③ 부동산
